note_title: 数列极限的平均与卷积型极限
summary_en: This note studies how limits behave under arithmetic averaging and a convolution-type average of two convergent sequences. It proves a Cesaro-type result and then extends the idea to show that \(\frac{x_1y_n+\cdots+x_ny_1}{n}\to AB\) when \(x_n\to A\) and \(y_n\to B\).

key_techniques: Cesaro mean of a convergent sequence
splitting the sum into finitely many initial terms and a tail

problems.statement_en: Assume \(x_n\to A\) and \(y_n\to B\). Prove that \(\frac{x_1y_n+\cdots+x_ny_1}{n}\to AB\).
problems.statement_zh: 假设\(x_n\to A,y_n \to B\)证明\(\frac{x_1y_n+\cdots +x_ny_1}{n}\to AB\)。
key_techniques: splitting the sum into initial segment and tail
asymptotic comparison with \(\sum_{k\le n} x_k y_k\)

key_techniques_discussed: splitting sums into finite and tail parts
asymptotic expansion via comparison with a simpler sum
